title: The canonical section cohomology comparison evaluated on cycles
statement: Let Y be a scheme, K a nonnegative complex of O_Y-modules, p a natural number and V an open of Y. Put P=(K.sc p).map U, where U forgets module sheaves to module presheaves, E the exact evaluation functor at V to additive groups, and k the inverse of the kernel comparison P.cycles≅U(K.cycles p). Then the cycle quotient for P.map E, followed by its homology evaluation comparison and E(sectionCohomologyTheta K p) [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], equals the cycle evaluation comparison followed by E(k) and evaluation at V of K.homologyπ p.

proof.text: For an exact left adjoint L with left-exact right adjoint U, precompose the adjoint homology comparison with the cycle quotient. Apply the adjunction equivalence and commute the quotient through L. Counit naturality and monicity of the cycle inclusion identify its cycles map with the inverse kernel comparison followed by the counit. Transport back across the adjunction.

Specialize this identity to the module-sheafification adjunction of the definition of theta. Exact evaluation commutes with cycles and homology and sends the identity to the stated equality at V. The proof works at every degree and every open.

theorem section_comparison_cycles {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf) ℕ)
    (p : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens) :
    let E := PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation Y.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op V)
    let P := (K.sc p).map (SheafOfModules.forget.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf)
    let k := (P.isoCyclesOfIsLimit (KernelFork.mapIsLimit _ (K.sc p).cyclesIsKernel
      (SheafOfModules.forget.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf))).inv
    (P.map E).homologyπ ≫ (P.mapHomologyIso E).hom ≫
        E.map (sectionCohomologyTheta K p) =
      (P.mapCyclesIso E).hom ≫ E.map k ≫ Hom.app (K.sc p).homologyπ V
